package myce

// Generator for testdata/r6.10-queue.sql. It compiles only against exact r6.10
// source (302620cacaace8a16e7ed424e1183dbb10f46414), never main:
//
//	git archive 302620cac go.mod go.sum internal cmd | tar -x -C SCRATCH
//	rm SCRATCH/internal/myce/*_test.go
//	cp internal/myce/testdata/r6.10-queue-seed_test.go.txt SCRATCH/internal/myce/r610_seed_test.go
//	(cd SCRATCH && SEED_DB=OUT/state/queue.db go test -run '^TestR610QueueSeed$' ./internal/myce)
//	sqlite3 OUT/state/queue.db .dump > internal/myce/testdata/r6.10-queue.sql

import (
	"context"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

type r610SeedClock struct{}

func (r610SeedClock) Now() time.Time { return time.Date(2026, 11, 10, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC) }

func TestR610QueueSeed(t *testing.T) {
	path := os.Getenv("SEED_DB")
	if path == "" {
		t.Skip("SEED_DB unset")
	}
	q, err := Open(path, filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(path), "checkpoints"), r610SeedClock{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer q.Close()
	m := Machine{ID: "fixture-device", HostID: "fixture-host", Session: "fixture-session", GPU: "cpu", FreeMemoryGB: 64, HostMemoryMeasured: true,
		CapabilityProfile: &CapabilityProfile{Version: 0, OS: runtime.GOOS, Arch: runtime.GOARCH, LogicalCPUs: 16, MemoryLayout: "separate", SystemMemoryBytes: 64 << 30}}
	server := httptest.NewServer(API{q, "fixture"}.Handler())
	client := Client{URL: server.URL, Token: "fixture"}
	var reply Reply
	err = client.Call(context.Background(), "POST", "/api/workers/checkin", Checkin{Machine: m, AttemptProtocol: "keyed-attempt-v1"}, &reply)
	server.Close()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	s := Spec{Name: "keyed", Project: "fixture", Priority: "experiment", SubmissionKey: "fixture-key"}
	s.Run.Command = []string{"echo", "done"}
	s.Needs.MemoryGB = 1
	s.Needs.Platform.Any = true
	if _, err = q.Submit(s); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	err = q.update(func() error {
		now := q.clock.Now()
		for _, state := range []string{"queued", "paused", "running", "succeeded", "failed"} {
			j := &Job{ID: "fixture-" + state, Spec: Spec{Name: state, Project: "fixture", Priority: "experiment"}, State: state, Queued: now}
			if state == "succeeded" || state == "failed" {
				j.FinishedAt = &now
			}
			if state == "succeeded" || state == "running" {
				j.Machine, j.Session, j.Attempt, j.StartedAt = m.ID, m.Session, 3, &now
			}
			if state == "failed" {
				// Larger than one SQLite page: stored as split field rows.
				j.Reason = strings.Repeat("retained failure evidence ", 1024)
			}
			q.putJob(j.ID, j)
		}
		r := HostRelease{Host: m.HostID, Machine: m.ID, Session: m.Session, Job: "fixture-succeeded", Attempt: 3, Until: now.Add(time.Hour)}
		q.s.HostReleases = map[string]HostRelease{releaseKey(r): r}
		q.appendHealthAlert(HealthAlert{Kind: "fixture", Machine: m.ID, Reason: "seeded"})
		return nil
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
